messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Plotting more than 3 traits
parts:
plot.scanone can plot just three sets of LOD curves as a time. If you want to include more, you need to do additional calls with add=TRUE, as follows:

ymx <- max(c(out.pheno1[,3], out.pheno2[,3], out.pheno3[,3], out.pheno4[,3]), na.rm=TRUE)
plot(out.pheno1, ylim=c(0, ymx))
plot(out.pheno2, color="blue", add=TRUE)
plot(out.pheno3, color="red", add=TRUE)
plot(out.pheno4, color="green", add=TRUE)

karl
